data.title: Sickness benefit (Krankengeld) rejected from 12 January 2026
data.summary: Muster BKK wrote on 27 January 2026 that your sickness benefit (Krankengeld) is suspended because your incapacity for work was reported late. It will only pay from 22 January 2026.
data.explanation: Your health insurer says your certificate of incapacity for work arrived on 22 January 2026, more than a week after it should have been reported. Because of this, your sickness benefit (Krankengeld) is not paid for the earlier period and starts only on 22 January 2026. If you disagree, for example because you reported it in time, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person with the insurer. The app shows the deadline. Keep proof of when you sent the certificate. A social advice service or a lawyer can help.

items.title: Object to the Krankengeld decision
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or in person with Muster BKK.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.

remedy.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
